From: chloe_martin <chloe.martin@redwood.inference>

Cc: avery_johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.inference>
Date: 2027-05-19T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Tiny Re-ignite — proposed newsletter cohort promo credits

Hi team,

Quick ask: Starlake (newsletter partner) has a small re-engagement slot next week targeting ~2.8k dormant trial signups (opened a trial in last 6 months, <5 calls). They can include a Redwood blurb with an exclusive promo code that grants a 14-day trial extension (no CC) and a small $15 usage credit when they upgrade within 30 days.

I ran a conservative estimate: if we allocate 1,000 promo codes from the marketing pool, expected redemptions ~8-12% with ~3% converting to paid within 30d. Estimated cost if all codes used: ~1,000 * $15 = $15,000 (redemption credit), plus expected token spend for active trials (~$1,200). Net expected CAC uplift and expansion signal positive — this is a low-risk experiment to re-activate churned trials.

What I need from you:
- Marissa: approval to take 1,000 promo codes from the event/partner pool for this campaign (or reassign from Demo-Day buffer).
- Ben: quick confirmation we can generate the codes and revoke any duplicates; also confirm we can track redemptions back to Starlake partner tag for reporting.
- Logan/Avery: do we want a stricter redemption cap per account and a 14-day redemption window? Any compliance concerns?

Attachments: tiny-reignite-proposal.pdf (one-pager) and draft promo-codes CSV that will be generated once approved.

Timing: partner needs final copy and code list by 05/21 EOD so they can include it in their 05/24 newsletter.

Thanks — this is small but high-velocity.

—Chloe
Chloe Martin
Sr. Growth Manager, Partner Programs
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Tiny Re-ignite — proposed newsletter cohort promo credits

Chloe — thanks for the clear ask and numbers. I approve allocating 1,000 promo codes from the Partner Promo pool (code bucket: PARTNER-2027-Q2). A couple of guardrails:

- Cap each receiving account to a single redemption to avoid giveaway stacking.
- Set promo code expiry to 14 days from send, and require the 14-day trial extension to be applied on first activation; credits expire after 60 days if unused.
- We'll treat the $15 credit as a revenue marketing expense; keep the ledger itemization so finance can attribute to deal DL-2027-052.

Ben — please confirm code generation and tag structure. Logan — if legal/compliance needs to sign off, loop in security but I think this is standard.

Marissa

Thanks for the quick turnaround, Chloe & team — sounds good. A few operational asks from the publisher side:

1) Can you confirm the exact redemption URL and UTM parameters so we can wire it into the CTA? We'll use utm_source=starlake&utm_medium=newsletter&utm_campaign=tiny_reignite_0524.
2) We need the CSV of codes by 05/21 EOD (US PST) to include in the editorial build.
3) Please confirm the trial-extension behavior: when a recipient redeems, do we extend the existing trial by 14 days (preserving remaining days) or grant a fresh 14-day trial starting at redemption? Publisher needs clarity for UX copy.

We will include the copy as: "Redeem an exclusive 14-day trial + $15 upgrade credit from Redwood Inference — no credit card required. Limited to one redemption per person. Redeem by MM/DD/YYYY."

Once we have the CSV and the redemption URL + instructions we will slot the blurb. Looking forward — Julie (Starlake)

—promo team

Julie / Promo team — thanks. Answers below and attaching the code CSV to the shared Drive.

- Redemption URL: https://app.redwood.inference/redeem?campaign=tiny_reignite&utm_source=starlake&utm_medium=newsletter&utm_campaign=tiny_reignite_0524
- UTM as proposed is correct.
- Trial behavior: we will extend existing trials by 14 days (preserving remaining days) — this avoids resetting progress for users who already have usage. The $15 upgrade credit is deposited to account balance upon upgrade (applies to the first paid invoice within 30 days).

Ben: I see the codes in the Drive (promo-codes-202705.csv) and I've confirmed with Marissa. Partner needs the file and editorial copy by 05/21 EOD — Ben, please drop the CSV to the Drive folder and ping me when done.

Copy for the publisher (approved):

"Try Redwood Inference free — claim a 14-day extension to your trial + a $15 upgrade credit when you upgrade within 30 days. No credit card required. Limited to one redemption per person. Redeem by 06/07/2027."

Thanks everyone — I'll follow up with a short report after the first week of sends to track opens/redemptions.

—Chloe
